params.name: databaseName
params.description: The name of the database to execute queries against. Use neo4j for the default database.

items.docs: Executes a Cypher query against the specified database using an implicit transaction. The server wraps the submitted Cypher query in a transaction automatically so that if any part of the query fails the database is reverted to its state before the query was executed. Multiple statements can be sent in a single request and the server runs them in sequence.
